metadata.title: [FEATURE][AUTH]: ABAC policy engine phase 2 — condition evaluator
metadata.author: LOVECAO1011

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #2019

---

## 📝 Summary
This PR reintroduces the Phase 2 ABAC condition evaluator on top of the latest `main` using a clean branch history.

It adds policy-condition evaluation logic and wiring in the policy engine, and updates tests accordingly.  
It also includes a compatibility fix so ABAC policy loading does not fail when `AccessPolicy` is not available in the current DB model layout.

---

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] Feature / Enhancement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling)
- [ ] Other (describe below)

---

| Check                     | Command         | Status |
|---------------------------|-----------------|--------|
| Lint suite                | `make lint`     | Not run (full suite not executed) |
| Unit tests                | `make test`     | ✅ Passed |
| Coverage ≥ 80%            | `make coverage` | Not run |

---

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [x] Tests added/updated for changes
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [x] No secrets or credentials committed

---

## 📓 Notes (optional)
- This supersedes the previous PR attempt that had heavy divergence/conflict issues.
- Branch was re-synced with latest `main` (after Phase 1) and Phase 2 changes were reapplied on top of the clean base.

commits.message:
feat(policy-engine): add phase2 ABAC condition evaluator and wiring

Introduce a JSON-based policy condition evaluator for subject/resource/context attributes with logical all/any/not composition, and wire AccessPolicy.conditions into PolicyEngine decision flow. Add focused phase2 unit tests plus phase1 compatibility coverage for allow/deny policy matching and fallback behavior.
